WME Fashion Incubator - Application Terms and Conditions

Your Application

 

1.  By submitting your application (“Application”) to WME Fashion a brand of IMG Worldwide, LLC (“WME”), you confirm and acknowledge the following:

You are over 18.

 

2. You have a portfolio of work and/or some demonstrable work experience in the subject matter for which you are seeking mentorship.

 

3. You are located in the U.S. and are based in New York City. It is anticipated that the majority of the WME’s Incubator programme will be conducted in person, although there will likely be additional virtual events.

 

4. The facts contained in your Application, portfolio of work and any other documentation you submit as part of the Application (together “Application Materials”) are true and complete to the best of your knowledge.  You understand that any false information or significant omissions may disqualify you from the application process.

 

5. The Application Materials are your own original work and to the extent that they include the work of any third-parties, you have all necessary consents, permissions and releases to use such work. To the best of your knowledge the Application Materials do not: (a) violate any right of privacy or publicity of any person, whether contractual, statutory, common law or otherwise and/or (b) infringe any intellectual property rights of any third party.

 

6. You agree to immediately notify WME if you are convicted of any crime while your Application is pending or during any period of your mentorship on the WME Incubator programme, if accepted.

 

7. On acceptance of a WME Incubator programme offer, you authorise the investigation of all statements contained in your Application (and accompanying Application Materials or cv/resume, if any) as allowable by applicable law and further authorise any person, school, current employer (except as expressly noted), past employer(s), whether or not named in your Application (and accompanying Application Materials or accompanying cv/resume, if any), to provide WME with records, information and opinion that may be useful in making a decision to offer you a place on the WME Incubator programme.  You release all such informants and WME from all liability for any decision, claim or damage that may result from furnishing and/or relying on such information and opinion (which is truthful or made in good faith) to you.

 

8. If your Application is successful and you accept a place on the WME Incubator programme, you acknowledge that you may be asked to enter into a mentorship agreement with WME  and any such mentorship agreement must be in writing.  You understand and acknowledge that any such written mentorship agreement would contain the precise terms of your mentorship with WME and would constitute the entire agreement between you and WME regarding the terms of the mentorship. Any such written agreement would supercede any other oral or written agreement, promises, assurances, understandings or statements made to you during any interview or discussions about the WME Incubator with WME.

 

9. Before submitting your Application, you agree to WME transferring your Application to the WME team (including recruitment personnel) in the US where the WME Incubator program is being offered and sharing information about your Application with a limited number of personnel elsewhere in the WME group of affiliates (which may be outside of your home country) in order to progress your Application. A list of these entities is available on request.

 

By submitting your Application, you agree that you have been provided with full Terms of Use for the Site, the Privacy Policy and Cookie Policy and have read, understood, accept and agreed to be bound by these Terms of Use and the processing of your Personal Data in accordance with the Privacy Policy.
